      <description><p>There is no end in sight for the drivers of illegal mining, while police action appears ineffective</p><p>Cora Bailey has been encountering illegal miners ever since she first started treating injured animals in the townships around Roodepoort, west of Johannesburg, in 1991.       <description><p>Cop30 host sets out steps to break link with coal, oil and gas as it aims to move focus from negotiating to implementing</p><p>All countries can start to break their dependence on fossil fuels now without needing to wait for new technologies or economic changes, Brazil’s government has said ahead of a global climate summit.</p><p>Brazil, the host of <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2025/nov/25/fossil-fuel-giants-finally-in-the-crosshairs-cop30-avoids-total-failure-with-last-ditch-deal">last year’s UN climate conference</a>, set out the world’s first global “roadmap” for phasing out fossil fuels on Tuesday, showing that countries could boost their economies and pull people out of poverty while breaking the link with coal, oil and gas.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/03/brazil-first-global-roadmap-phasing-out-fossil-fuels">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Residents send message on deportations while grassroots organizers aim to prevent federal election interference</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/03/midterm-election-results-live-updates">US midterm elections – live updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li></ul><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/minnesota">Minnesota</a> voters left “I Voted” stickers on memorial sites for Alex Pretti and Renee Nicole Good, the two US citizens killed by federal immigration officials earlier this year, while organizers in the area deployed their “democracy guardians” to visit and monitor polling sites for disturbances or the federal government.</p><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/29/who-is-alex-pretti-ice-minneapolis-shooting">Pretti</a>, a 37-year-old intensive care unit nurse at the Veterans Affairs medical center in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/08/minnesota-ice-shooting-nicole-macklin-good">Good</a>, a writer and mother of three, were killed during a large-scale immigration enforcement operation in the Minneapolis region in January.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/03/minneapolis-i-voted-stickers-alex-pretti-memorial">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Victory for the party comes despite unusual and aggressive efforts by Republicans to redraw congressional districts</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/03/midterm-election-results-live-updates">US midterm elections – live updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li></ul><p>Democrats are poised to take control of the US House of Representatives after two tumultuous years of Donald Trump’s second presidency. (There is one vacancy in a Republican seat and one vacancy in a Democratic seat, and one Republican member switched his party affiliation to independent.)       <description><p>Roy Cooper wins election in North Carolina as Democrats hope disapproval with Trump gives them advantage</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/03/midterm-election-results-live-updates">US midterm elections – live updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li></ul><p>Democrat Roy Cooper has won the US Senate election in North Carolina, the Associated Press reports, a significant victory for Donald Trump’s foes in their quest to regain control of Congress’s upper chamber.</p><p>North Carolina has not elected a Democrat to the US Senate since 2008, and the success of Cooper, a former governor, brings his party one seat closer to retaking control of a chamber they lost two years ago, when Trump returned to the White House.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/03/democrats-senate-midterm-elections-results">Continue reading...</a></description>
